words.enDefinition: a long formal paper presenting your own analysis of a topic

examples.en: My sociology professor wants a ten-page research paper by the end of April.
examples.zh: 社会学教授要求四月底交一篇十页的「研究论文」。

examples.en: Before drafting your research paper, narrow the topic to what the sources can support.
examples.zh: 动笔写「研究论文」之前，先把题目缩小到资料撑得住的范围。

collocations: cite sources in a research paper

words.enDefinition: the specific question a study or paper sets out to answer

examples.en: After reading five articles, I still need to sharpen my research question.
examples.zh: 读完五篇文章后，我仍需把「研究问题」再聚焦一些。

examples.en: A good research question is narrow enough to answer within the word limit.
examples.zh: 好的「研究问题」要窄到能在字数限制内回答。

words.enDefinition: an area that existing studies have not yet examined

examples.en: My proposal argues that the research gap lies in first-generation students' study habits.
examples.zh: 我的开题报告认为「研究空白」在于第一代大学生的学习习惯。

examples.en: The professor asked how my thesis fills a research gap in the field.
examples.zh: 教授问我的论文如何填补该领域的「研究空白」。

words.enDefinition: an original document or firsthand account from the period studied

examples.en: For the history essay, soldiers' wartime letters count as primary sources.
examples.zh: 历史课论文里，士兵的战时书信属于「一手资料」。

examples.en: Interviews I conduct myself are primary sources, while news reports about them are secondary.
examples.zh: 我自己做的访谈是「一手资料」，相关的新闻报道则是二手的。

words.enDefinition: a work that interprets primary materials, such as a review article

examples.en: Textbooks and review articles are secondary sources, so cite the original study when possible.
examples.zh: 教科书和综述属于「二手资料」，所以尽量引用原始研究。

examples.en: My professor allows at most three secondary sources in the annotated bibliography.
examples.zh: 教授要求注释书目里的「二手资料」最多不超过三个。

words.enDefinition: findings drawn from observation, experiments, or measurable data

examples.en: Her argument is persuasive because it rests on empirical evidence from three surveys.
examples.zh: 她的论证很有说服力，因为它建立在三份调查的「实证证据」之上。

examples.en: The literature review section should connect your hypothesis to existing empirical evidence.
examples.zh: 文献综述部分应把你的假设与已有「实证证据」联系起来。

words.enDefinition: research exploring experiences through interviews and observation rather than numbers

examples.en: Her qualitative research uses interviews with twenty international students about library anxiety.
examples.zh: 她的「质性研究」访谈了二十名留学生，探讨图书馆焦虑。

examples.en: Qualitative research findings are rich, but the sample is usually small.
examples.zh: 「质性研究」的发现很丰富，但样本通常较小。

words.enDefinition: research based on numbers, statistics, and measurable variables

examples.en: The methods course separates quantitative research, which uses statistics, from interview-based work.
examples.zh: 研究方法课把用统计的「定量研究」与基于访谈的研究区分开。

examples.en: His thesis combines quantitative research on grades with interviews about motivation.
examples.zh: 他的论文把成绩方面的「定量研究」与动机访谈结合起来。

words.enDefinition: a design combining numerical data with interviews or observation

examples.en: Our capstone uses mixed methods: a campus survey plus follow-up interviews.
examples.zh: 我们的毕业项目采用「混合研究方法」：全校问卷加后续访谈。

examples.en: The professor praised our mixed methods approach for balancing numbers with stories.
examples.zh: 教授称赞我们的「混合研究方法」兼顾了数字与个案故事。

words.enDefinition: an organized collection of records ready for analysis

examples.en: The professor shared a data set of five hundred survey responses for our project.
examples.zh: 教授分享了一个含五百份问卷回答的「数据集」供我们做项目。

examples.en: Cleaning the data set took longer than running the actual analysis.
examples.zh: 清理「数据集」花的时间比真正做分析还长。

words.enDefinition: unprocessed records collected directly from sources or instruments

examples.en: Submit your raw data as an appendix so the grader can check the calculations.
examples.zh: 把「原始数据」放在附录里提交，方便老师核对计算。

examples.en: Never edit raw data directly; work on a copy in Excel.
examples.zh: 不要直接改「原始数据」，要在 Excel 副本上操作。

words.enDefinition: the number of participants or cases included in a study

examples.en: The reviewer criticized our sample size of fifteen as too small for conclusions.
examples.zh: 审稿人批评我们十五人的「样本量」太小，得不出结论。

examples.en: A larger sample size would make the survey results more convincing.
examples.zh: 更大的「样本量」会让问卷结果更有说服力。

words.enDefinition: the comparison group in an experiment that receives no treatment

examples.en: Participants in the control group simply studied without the new app.
examples.zh: 「对照组」的参与者照常学习，不使用新应用。

examples.en: Our psychology experiment needs a control group to make the results meaningful.
examples.zh: 我们的心理学实验需要「对照组」，否则结果没有意义。

words.enDefinition: the likelihood a result reflects a real pattern rather than chance

examples.en: The difference in test scores reached statistical significance after we added more participants.
examples.zh: 增加被试之后，成绩差异达到了「统计显著性」。

examples.en: Report p-values when you claim statistical significance in your results section.
examples.zh: 在结果部分声称「统计显著性」时，要报告 p 值。

words.enDefinition: the results and conclusions that a study reports

examples.en: Summarize the article's research findings in two sentences before critiquing the methods.
examples.zh: 批判研究方法之前，先用两句话概括文章的「研究发现」。

examples.en: Our research findings suggest that freshmen rarely use the academic databases.
examples.zh: 我们的「研究发现」表明，大一学生很少用学术数据库。

words.enDefinition: a peer-reviewed periodical publishing original research articles

examples.en: For this assignment, at least five of your eight sources must come from academic journals.
examples.zh: 这次作业要求八个来源中至少五个来自「学术期刊」。

examples.en: Articles in academic journals list their authors' affiliations and an abstract at the top.
examples.zh: 「学术期刊」的文章开头会列出作者单位和摘要。

words.enDefinition: a single research paper published within a journal issue

examples.en: I found a 2022 journal article that supports exactly my argument about tutoring.
examples.zh: 我找到一篇2022年的「期刊论文」，正好支持我的论点。

examples.en: Each journal article ends with a reference list you can mine for more sources.
examples.zh: 每篇「期刊论文」末尾的参考文献列表都能顺藤摸瓜找更多资料。

words.enDefinition: a journal whose articles experts vet before publication

examples.en: Wikipedia is fine for orientation, but your evidence must come from peer-reviewed journals.
examples.zh: 维基百科可以入门，但论据必须来自「同行评审期刊」。

examples.en: Our librarian showed us how to filter results to peer-reviewed journals only.
examples.zh: 馆员教我们如何把检索结果筛选为仅限「同行评审期刊」。

words.enDefinition: expert checking of a manuscript before publication

examples.en: Once a paper passes peer review, it carries much more academic weight.
examples.zh: 论文一旦通过「同行评审」，学术分量就大得多。

examples.en: Peer review takes months, which is why preprints circulate earlier.
examples.zh: 「同行评审」耗时数月，所以预印本会更早流通。

words.enDefinition: a short paper presented and discussed at an academic conference

examples.en: My advisor wants to turn my thesis chapter into a conference paper.
examples.zh: 导师想让我把论文的一章改写成一篇「会议论文」。

examples.en: She presented her conference paper on code-switching at the linguistics conference in March.
examples.zh: 三月的语言学会议上，她宣读了关于语码转换的「会议论文」。

words.enDefinition: the published collection of papers given at a conference

examples.en: Cite the conference proceedings volume, not just the slide deck, in your references.
examples.zh: 参考文献要引「会议论文集」的卷次，而不只是幻灯片。

examples.en: Her talk isn't published yet, but the conference proceedings should appear online this summer.
examples.zh: 她的报告还没刊出，「会议论文集」今夏应该会上线。

words.enDefinition: a session where researchers discuss work displayed on posters

examples.en: Undergraduates from our lab will present two projects at Friday's poster session.
examples.zh: 我们实验室的本科生将在周五的「海报展示」介绍两个项目。

examples.en: Dress business casual for the poster session; professors from other universities always circulate.
examples.zh: 「海报展示」要穿商务休闲装，外校教授会来回交流。

words.enDefinition: the invited speaker who opens a conference with a major talk

examples.en: The keynote speaker this year is the sociologist who coined that famous term.
examples.zh: 今年的「主旨发言人」正是提出那个著名术语的社会学家。

examples.en: Graduate students can attend the keynote speaker's lecture for free with their student ID.
examples.zh: 研究生凭学生证可以免费听「主旨发言人」的讲座。

words.enDefinition: a paper shared online before peer review is complete

examples.en: The preprint is free on arXiv, but the final version sits behind a paywall.
examples.zh: 「预印本」在 arXiv 上免费，定稿版本却在付费墙内。

examples.en: Be careful citing a preprint; the published version may differ after peer review.
examples.zh: 引用「预印本」要谨慎，正式版经同行评审后可能有改动。

words.enDefinition: free public availability of research articles online

examples.en: Because the paper is open access, I can download the PDF legally from the journal site.
examples.zh: 这篇论文属于「开放获取」，我可以从期刊官网合法下载 PDF。

examples.en: Our library promotes open access journals so students without subscriptions can still read.
examples.zh: 图书馆推广「开放获取」期刊，没有订阅权限的学生也能阅读。

words.enDefinition: a barrier blocking full articles until you pay or log in

examples.en: I hit a paywall trying to download the article from my laptop at home.
examples.zh: 我在家用笔记本下载文章时遇到了「付费墙」。

examples.en: Log in through the library portal first; that usually bypasses the paywall.
examples.zh: 先通过图书馆门户登录，通常就能绕过「付费墙」。

words.enDefinition: the complete article or book, not just its abstract

examples.en: The database shows only the abstract, so I requested the full text through interlibrary loan.
examples.zh: 数据库只显示摘要，我通过馆际互借申请了「全文」。

examples.en: Click the Find Full Text button to check whether our library subscribes.
examples.zh: 点击「全文」获取按钮，看看图书馆是否订阅该刊。

words.enDefinition: a permanent web address uniquely identifying an academic paper

examples.en: Every reference in APA format should include the DOI when one exists.
examples.zh: 有「数字对象标识符」（DOI）的文献，在 APA 格式里都应标出。

examples.en: Copy the DOI from the article page and paste it into Zotero's magic wand field.
examples.zh: 从文章页面复制「数字对象标识符」（DOI），粘到 Zotero 的魔法棒输入框。

words.enDefinition: a stable database link that will not break later

examples.en: Save the permalink from the database record, not the long session URL in your browser bar.
examples.zh: 要保存数据库记录里的「永久链接」，而不是地址栏里带会话参数的长网址。

examples.en: The permalink broke because I copied it while logged in through the proxy.
examples.zh: 因为我是走代理登录时复制的，「永久链接」失效了。

words.enDefinition: a score measuring how often a journal's articles are cited

examples.en: My professor warned us not to judge an article by the journal's impact factor alone.
examples.zh: 教授提醒我们，不要只凭期刊「影响因子」判断文章好坏。

examples.en: Journals with a high impact factor reject most submissions, so plan backup venues.
examples.zh: 「影响因子」高的期刊大多会拒稿，所以要准备备选投稿去向。

words.enDefinition: the number of later papers that have cited a work

examples.en: Sort the results by citation count to see which studies influence the field most.
examples.zh: 按「被引次数」排序，看看哪些研究对领域影响最大。

examples.en: A high citation count usually means the paper is a safe, central source.
examples.zh: 「被引次数」高通常说明这篇论文是可靠的核心文献。

words.enDefinition: reviewing where authors and reviewers know nothing of each other

examples.en: For double-blind review, remove your name from the manuscript before uploading.
examples.zh: 「双盲评审」要求上传前把手稿上的姓名删掉。

examples.en: Our class ran a double-blind review so graders couldn't tell whose essay they were reading.
examples.zh: 我们班采用「双盲评审」，批改老师看不出文章是谁写的。

words.enDefinition: a published paper withdrawn because of errors or misconduct

examples.en: The database flagged one retracted paper in my saved folder, so I removed it.
examples.zh: 数据库提示我收藏夹里有一篇「撤稿论文」，我就移除了。

examples.en: Always check for a retraction notice before building an argument on a retracted paper.
examples.zh: 在基于「撤稿论文」构建论点前，务必查看撤稿声明。

words.enDefinition: a fake journal charging fees without genuine peer review

examples.en: That email inviting me to submit was from a predatory journal, not a real one.
examples.zh: 那封邀稿邮件来自「掠夺性期刊」，不是真正的学术刊物。

examples.en: Check each journal against our library's whitelist to avoid predatory journals.
examples.zh: 投稿前先对照图书馆的白名单，避开「掠夺性期刊」。

words.enDefinition: a searchable collection of scholarly articles the library subscribes to

examples.en: Our library pays for academic databases like JSTOR and PsycINFO, so start there instead of Google.
examples.zh: 图书馆付费购买了 JSTOR、PsycINFO 等「学术数据库」，请优先使用。

examples.en: Each academic database covers different fields, so ask a librarian which one fits your topic.
examples.zh: 每个「学术数据库」覆盖的领域不同，可以问馆员哪个适合你的题目。

words.enDefinition: the search tool listing every book and holding the library owns

examples.en: The library catalog shows the call number, so you can find the book on the shelves yourself.
examples.zh: 「馆藏目录」会显示索书号，你可以自己去书架上找书。

examples.en: Type the author's last name into the library catalog to see all their holdings.
examples.zh: 在「馆藏目录」里输入作者姓氏，就能看到馆藏的所有著作。

words.enDefinition: searching with AND, OR, and NOT operators to combine keywords

examples.en: Use a Boolean search with AND to require both climate and migration in the results.
examples.zh: 用「布尔检索」的 AND 运算符，让结果同时包含气候与移民。

examples.en: The librarian taught us Boolean search so we could narrow thousands of hits to a dozen.
examples.zh: 馆员教我们「布尔检索」，把上千条结果缩小到十几条。

words.enDefinition: the exact keyword and operator combination typed into a database

examples.en: Save your search string so you can rerun it in other databases later.
examples.zh: 把「检索式」存下来，之后可在其他数据库里重复运行。

examples.en: My search string used quotation marks around social media to keep the phrase together.
examples.zh: 我的「检索式」给 social media 加了引号，让它作为整体短语检索。

words.enDefinition: using quotation marks to force exact multi-word matches

examples.en: Put quotation marks around social media anxiety for a phrase search instead of separate words.
examples.zh: 给 social media anxiety 加引号做「短语检索」，而不是分开搜单词。

examples.en: A phrase search returned forty results, while the loose search returned four thousand.
examples.zh: 「短语检索」只返回四十条结果，松散检索却返回了四千条。

words.enDefinition: using a symbol like an asterisk to match word endings

examples.en: Typing migra* is truncation, so it retrieves migrant, migration, and migratory at once.
examples.zh: 输入 migra* 就是「截词检索」，能同时命中 migrant 和 migration。

examples.en: Truncation broadens results, so pair the asterisk with a narrow Boolean operator.
examples.zh: 「截词检索」会扩大结果，星号要配合窄化的布尔运算符使用。

words.enDefinition: a symbol replacing one or more letters in a search term

examples.en: Use a wildcard like wom?n to search both woman and women.
examples.zh: 用 wom?n 这样的「通配符」能同时搜到 woman 和 women。

examples.en: Each database has its own wildcard rules, so check the help page first.
examples.zh: 每个数据库的「通配符」规则不同，先看帮助页面。

words.enDefinition: a search page with separate boxes for several fields

examples.en: Switch to advanced search to limit each keyword to the title field.
examples.zh: 切换到「高级检索」，可以把关键词限定在标题字段。

examples.en: In advanced search you can combine three fields instead of one long line.
examples.zh: 在「高级检索」里可以组合三个字段，而不是写一长串。

words.enDefinition: a sidebar option limiting results by date, type, or language

examples.en: Apply a search filter for the last five years to keep sources current.
examples.zh: 加一个近五年的「筛选条件」，保证文献足够新。

examples.en: The peer-reviewed search filter saved me from wading through blog posts.
examples.zh: 同行评审的「筛选条件」让我不用再翻一堆博客文章。

words.enDefinition: the standardized term databases use to tag each article

examples.en: Once you find one good article, click its subject heading to find similar ones.
examples.zh: 找到一篇好文章后，点它的「主题词」就能找到类似文献。

examples.en: Subject headings differ across databases, so note the exact term for each one.
examples.zh: 不同数据库的「主题词」不一样，要分别记下准确用词。

words.enDefinition: following reference lists and citing articles to find related work

examples.en: Citation chaining backward through her reference list uncovered the classic 1998 study.
examples.zh: 沿着她的参考文献列表做「引文追溯」，找到了1998年的经典研究。

examples.en: Google Scholar's cited-by link makes forward citation chaining much faster.
examples.zh: 谷歌学术的被引用链接让正向「引文追溯」快得多。

words.enDefinition: using your university login to reach subscriptions from home

examples.en: Off-campus access stopped working until I renewed my library account online.
examples.zh: 我在网上续期图书馆账户后，「校外访问」才恢复正常。

examples.en: Sign in with your student ID to set up off-campus access for the databases.
examples.zh: 用学号登录，设置好数据库的「校外访问」权限。

words.enDefinition: a free search engine indexing scholarly articles and citations

examples.en: I set Google Scholar to show links to our library's full-text holdings.
examples.zh: 我把「谷歌学术」设置成显示我们图书馆的全文链接。

examples.en: Google Scholar profiles let you track a professor's publications and citation counts.
examples.zh: 「谷歌学术」主页可以追踪某位教授的论文和被引数据。

words.enDefinition: a subscription database archiving journals across humanities and social sciences

examples.en: JSTOR archives older issues, so look elsewhere for papers from the last two years.
examples.zh: 「JSTOR数据库」以过刊为主，近两年的论文要去别处找。

examples.en: Our library's JSTOR subscription saved me twenty dollars on one article alone.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「JSTOR数据库」订阅让我单篇文章就省了二十美元。

words.enDefinition: a service borrowing books or articles from other libraries for you

examples.en: Interlibrary loan got me the chapter our library didn't own, scanned in two days.
examples.zh: 通过「馆际互借」，我们馆没有的那一章两天内就扫描发来了。

examples.en: Submit an interlibrary loan request early, because delivery can take two weeks.
examples.zh: 「馆际互借」申请要趁早，因为寄送可能要两周。

words.enDefinition: the required system for formatting citations, such as APA or MLA

examples.en: Check the syllabus before you start; each professor picks a different citation style.
examples.zh: 动笔前先看课程大纲，每位教授规定的「引用格式」都不同。

examples.en: Switching citation styles is easy in Zotero once your references are imported.
examples.zh: 文献导入 Zotero 后，切换「引用格式」很容易。

words.enDefinition: the author-date citation system common in psychology and education

examples.en: APA style puts the year right after the author's name in every in-text citation.
examples.zh: 「APA格式」要求在文中引用的作者名后紧跟年份。

examples.en: The nursing department follows APA style, so my lab reports use author-date citations.
examples.zh: 护理系采用「APA格式」，所以实验报告用作者—年份式引用。

words.enDefinition: the citation system used in literature and humanities courses

examples.en: MLA style asks for the author and page number, not the year.
examples.zh: 「MLA格式」要求标注作者和页码，而不是年份。

examples.en: My literature professor grades the works cited page strictly by MLA style rules.
examples.zh: 文学教授会严格按照「MLA格式」给引用文献列表评分。

words.enDefinition: the citation system using footnotes, common in history courses

examples.en: Chicago style relies on footnotes, which history professors prefer for primary sources.
examples.zh: 「芝加哥格式」使用脚注，历史系教授更喜欢用它处理一手资料。

examples.en: The Chicago style manual offers two systems: notes-bibliography and author-date.
examples.zh: 「芝加哥格式」手册提供注释—书目和作者—年份两套体系。

words.enDefinition: the official style book defining a citation system's rules

examples.en: The APA publication manual's seventh edition changed how up to twenty authors are listed.
examples.zh: APA「官方格式手册」第七版改动了列出至多二十位作者的规则。

examples.en: Keep the publication manual next to your laptop while formatting references.
examples.zh: 排版参考文献时，把「官方格式手册」放在电脑旁。

collocations: latest edition of the publication manual

words.enDefinition: a short departmental document summarizing citation and formatting rules

examples.en: The history department's style guide condenses Chicago style into four pages.
examples.zh: 历史系的「格式指南」把芝加哥格式浓缩成了四页。

examples.en: Download the writing center's style guide before you format your first draft.
examples.zh: 排初稿格式之前，先下载写作中心的「格式指南」。

words.enDefinition: a model document showing correct formatting for a citation style

examples.en: Purdue OWL's sample paper shows exactly where the running head goes.
examples.zh: 普渡 OWL 的「示例论文」清楚标出页眉应在的位置。

examples.en: Compare your title page against the sample paper before submitting.
examples.zh: 提交前，把你的扉页与「示例论文」对照一遍。

words.enDefinition: a short source note placed inside the paper's body

examples.en: Every quotation needs an in-text citation with a page number in APA style.
examples.zh: 在 APA 格式里，每处引文都需要带页码的「文内引用」。

examples.en: My professor circled a whole paragraph and wrote, missing in-text citation.
examples.zh: 教授圈出我草稿的一整段，批注缺少「文内引用」。

collocations: in-text citation with a page number

words.enDefinition: a source note in parentheses at the sentence's end

examples.en: Put the parenthetical citation before the final period, not after it.
examples.zh: 「括号夹注」要放在句号之前，而不是之后。

examples.en: A parenthetical citation such as (Chen 45) is standard in MLA style.
examples.zh: 像 (Chen 45) 这样的「括号夹注」是 MLA 格式的标准写法。

words.enDefinition: a citation where the author's name is spoken in your sentence

examples.en: A narrative citation reads naturally: Chen argues that dorms shape study habits.
examples.zh: 「叙述式引用」读起来很自然：Chen 认为宿舍塑造学习习惯。

examples.en: Mix narrative citations with parenthetical ones so paragraphs do not feel mechanical.
examples.zh: 「叙述式引用」与括号夹注交替使用，段落才不会显得死板。

collocations: narrative citation with a signal verb

words.enDefinition: a short phrase introducing a quotation with the author's name

examples.en: A signal phrase like “According to Chen” keeps the quotation tied to your argument.
examples.zh: 像 According to Chen 这样的「引述语」能让引文紧扣你的论点。

examples.en: Vary your signal phrases; not every source can merely claim or state.
examples.zh: 「引述语」要多变换，别每条来源都只会用 claim 或 state。

collocations: introduce a quotation with a signal phrase

words.enDefinition: the MLA list of every source actually cited in the paper

examples.en: The works cited page starts on a new page with the title centered.
examples.zh: 「引用文献列表」要另起一页，标题居中。

examples.en: Alphabetize the works cited list by the first author's surname.
examples.zh: 「引用文献列表」按第一作者姓氏的字母顺序排列。

words.enDefinition: a list of sources consulted, whether or not directly cited

examples.en: Chicago style ends with a bibliography that may include background reading.
examples.zh: 芝加哥格式在文末附「文献目录」，可包含仅作背景阅读的书。

examples.en: The bibliography may list works you read for background but never cited.
examples.zh: 「文献目录」可以列出你读过但从未直接引用的著作。

words.enDefinition: a source list where each entry is followed by a summary paragraph

examples.en: Write three sentences per source for the annotated bibliography due Friday.
examples.zh: 周五要交的「注释文献目录」，每条来源写三句话。

examples.en: An annotated bibliography forced me to actually read each article before citing it.
examples.zh: 「注释文献目录」逼我在引用前认真读完每篇文章。

words.enDefinition: a note at the page bottom giving extra details or citation

examples.en: Put the archival details in a footnote so the main text stays readable.
examples.zh: 把档案细节放进「脚注」，正文才不会太啰嗦。

examples.en: Chicago style numbers each footnote with a superscript in the sentence.
examples.zh: 芝加哥格式在句中用上标编号标出每个「脚注」。

collocations: footnote at the bottom of the page

words.enDefinition: a note collected at the paper's end instead of each page

examples.en: Our professor prefers endnotes, so all notes gather before the bibliography.
examples.zh: 教授要求用「尾注」，所有注释都集中在文献目录之前。

examples.en: Converting footnotes to endnotes takes just one click in Word.
examples.zh: 在 Word 里一键就能把脚注转换成「尾注」。

words.enDefinition: a long quotation set off as its own indented paragraph

examples.en: Any quotation longer than four lines becomes a block quote in APA style.
examples.zh: 在 APA 格式里，超过四行的引文要排成「整段引文」。

examples.en: Do not overuse the block quote; professors want mostly your own voice.
examples.zh: 不要滥用「整段引文」，教授想看到的主要是你自己的论述。

words.enDefinition: paired marks showing someone's exact spoken or written words

examples.en: Copy three-word phrases into quotation marks too, not just whole sentences.
examples.zh: 三个词的短语也要放进「引号」，而不只是整句。

examples.en: Periods and commas go inside the quotation marks in American English.
examples.zh: 美式英语里，句号和逗号要放在「引号」内。

words.enDefinition: an author's words copied exactly inside quotation marks

examples.en: Balance each direct quote with your own analysis, or the paragraph reads like a copy-paste.
examples.zh: 每处「直接引文」都要配上自己的分析，否则段落像复制粘贴。

examples.en: Limit each direct quote to one or two sentences in a short essay.
examples.zh: 短文里每处「直接引文」控制在一两句以内。

collocations: direct quote with a page number

words.enDefinition: three dots showing words were cut from a quotation

examples.en: Use an ellipsis to cut the middle of the sentence without changing its meaning.
examples.zh: 用「省略号」删掉句子中段，但不能改变原意。

examples.en: An ellipsis at the start of a quote looks sloppy, so begin at a natural break.
examples.zh: 「省略号」放在引文开头显得潦草，应从自然停顿处开始引用。

words.enDefinition: marks used to insert clarifying words inside a quotation

examples.en: Use square brackets to replace a pronoun with the actual name inside the quote.
examples.zh: 在引文里用「方括号」把代词换成真实姓名。

examples.en: Square brackets show readers that the insertion is yours, not the author's.
examples.zh: 「方括号」告诉读者，插入的文字是你的，不是原作者的。

words.enDefinition: a bracketed note showing an odd phrase appeared that way originally

examples.en: Add [sic] after a typo you quote so readers know it is the author's error.
examples.zh: 引用原作的错字后加上「原文如此」（[sic]），读者就知道那是作者的笔误。

examples.en: Never quietly correct the source; mark it with [sic] instead.
examples.zh: 不要悄悄改掉原文，应加「原文如此」（[sic]）标注。

words.enDefinition: a short form meaning and others, used for three or more authors

examples.en: APA style lists every author the first time; afterwards use et al.
examples.zh: APA 格式首次列出全部作者，之后用「等人」（et al.）。

examples.en: In formal writing, cite three or more authors as Chen et al., not as a full list.
examples.zh: 正式写作里，三位以上作者引用为 Chen「等人」（et al.），不必全列。

words.enDefinition: a footnote word meaning the same source as the previous note

examples.en: Use ibid when consecutive footnotes cite the same book, then add the new page.
examples.zh: 相邻脚注引同一本书时用「同上」（ibid），再标新页码。

examples.en: Ibids save space, but Chicago style now discourages long chains of them.
examples.zh: 「同上」能省篇幅，但芝加哥格式现在不鼓励连着用一长串。

words.enDefinition: the printed page location cited after a quotation

examples.en: MLA style requires the page number in every citation, even for a paraphrase.
examples.zh: MLA 格式每处引用都要标「页码」，转述也不例外。

examples.en: The PDF's stable layout keeps the page number reliable for citations.
examples.zh: PDF 版式固定，「页码」作为引用位置更可靠。

words.enDefinition: the first and last pages of an article in a reference entry

examples.en: The reference entry must include the article's full page range after the issue number.
examples.zh: 参考文献条目要在期号之后标出文章完整的「页码范围」。

examples.en: Copy the page range from the database record, not from your printed excerpt.
examples.zh: 「页码范围」要从数据库记录里抄，不要按打印的节选填。

words.enDefinition: the yearly series number of a journal, listed before the issue

examples.en: APA style italicizes the volume number but not the issue number in parentheses.
examples.zh: APA 格式里「卷号」要斜体，括号内的期号不用。

examples.en: Copy the volume number from the article's header, not from the search results list.
examples.zh: 「卷号」要从文章页眉里抄，不要照搬检索结果列表。

words.enDefinition: the number of a journal issue within its volume

examples.en: The issue number goes in parentheses right after the volume in APA references.
examples.zh: APA 参考文献里，「期号」用括号紧跟在卷号之后。

examples.en: Without the issue number, readers may retrieve the wrong article with the same title.
examples.zh: 缺了「期号」，读者可能检索到同名的另一篇文章。

words.enDefinition: reference formatting where the first line sits left and later lines indent

examples.en: Every entry on the works cited page needs a hanging indent of half an inch.
examples.zh: 引用文献列表上每条记录都需要半英寸的「悬挂缩进」。

examples.en: Set the hanging indent once in paragraph settings, and Word applies it to new entries.
examples.zh: 在段落设置里一次性设好「悬挂缩进」，新增条目会自动应用。

words.enDefinition: capitalizing main words in a title, as book titles require

examples.en: Journal titles in APA references use title case, while article titles use sentence case.
examples.zh: APA 参考文献中，期刊名用「标题式大小写」，文章标题则用句首大写。

examples.en: MLA style applies title case to almost every title in your works cited list.
examples.zh: MLA 格式里，引用文献列表中几乎所有标题都用「标题式大小写」。

words.enDefinition: slanted type used for book titles and journal names

examples.en: Book titles take italics, but chapter titles stay plain in most styles.
examples.zh: 多数引用格式中，书名用「斜体」，章节名则不用。

examples.en: Don't italicize the issue number; only the journal name and volume take italics.
examples.zh: 期号不要用「斜体」，只有期刊名和卷号才用斜体。

words.enDefinition: citing a source found quoted inside another author's work

examples.en: Write as cited in when you make a secondary citation instead of pretending you read the original.
examples.zh: 做「转引」时要写 as cited in，不要假装读过原始文献。

examples.en: Secondary citations are a last resort; hunt for the original study in the databases first.
examples.zh: 「转引」是下策，应先在数据库里找原始研究。

collocations: as cited in for secondary citations

words.enDefinition: to quote a source inaccurately, changing its wording or meaning

examples.en: Professors notice when students misquote an article to fit their argument.
examples.zh: 学生为贴合论点而「误引」文章时，教授一眼就能看出来。

examples.en: Always reread the original page before quoting, because paraphrasing from memory can misquote.
examples.zh: 引用前务必重读原文，凭记忆转述容易「误引」。

words.enDefinition: giving clear credit to the source of an idea or phrase

examples.en: Proper attribution means naming the author, even when you paraphrase in your own words.
examples.zh: 做到「注明出处」就要提到作者，即使你用自己的话转述。

examples.en: The rubric awards points for accurate attribution of every borrowed idea.
examples.zh: 评分标准规定，每个借用观点的「注明出处」都计分。

words.enDefinition: software storing references and inserting formatted citations while you write

examples.en: A citation manager like Zotero saves hours of formatting at three in the morning.
examples.zh: 像 Zotero 这样的「文献管理软件」能省下凌晨三点调格式的时间。

examples.en: Our writing center workshop introduced every citation manager the library supports.
examples.zh: 写作中心的工作坊介绍了图书馆支持的所有「文献管理软件」。

words.enDefinition: a free citation manager grabbing sources straight from the browser

examples.en: Zotero's browser connector saves the article's metadata and PDF with one click.
examples.zh: 「Zotero」的浏览器插件一键就能保存文章的元数据和 PDF。

examples.en: I sync my Zotero library across devices so thesis writing continues in the computer lab.
examples.zh: 我把「Zotero」文库多端同步，在机房也能接着写论文。

words.enDefinition: a citation manager popular with science students for organizing PDFs

examples.en: Mendeley groups my readings by project and highlights PDFs alongside them.
examples.zh: 「Mendeley」按项目为文献分组，还能在 PDF 上做高亮。

examples.en: My lab mates prefer Mendeley because it suggests related papers while we read.
examples.zh: 实验室同学更喜欢「Mendeley」，因为阅读时它会推荐相关论文。

words.enDefinition: inserting citations into a document directly from a manager plugin

examples.en: With cite while you write, the reference list updates itself as you draft.
examples.zh: 用「边写边引」插件，草稿写到哪里，参考文献列表就自动更新到哪里。

examples.en: Learn cite while you write early in the semester, not during finals week.
examples.zh: 「边写边引」要开学初就学，别拖到考试周。

words.enDefinition: a website building a formatted reference from a URL or ISBN

examples.en: Check every citation generator result by hand; they frequently mess up capitalization.
examples.zh: 「引文生成器」的结果都要手动核对，大小写经常出错。

examples.en: I used a citation generator for the rough draft, then fixed the entries in Zotero.
examples.zh: 初稿我用「引文生成器」生成引文，之后在 Zotero 里逐条修正。

words.enDefinition: to move citation records into your manager from a database or file

examples.en: Import references directly from EBSCO using the exported RIS file.
examples.zh: 用导出的 RIS 文件从 EBSCO「导入文献」。

examples.en: Import references in bulk instead of typing authors one by one.
examples.zh: 「导入文献」要批量进行，别逐条手输作者名。

collocations: import references via a RIS file

words.enDefinition: to save citation records out of a database into a file

examples.en: Select the checkbox beside each hit before you export citations from the database.
examples.zh: 从数据库「导出引文」前，先勾选每条命中的记录。

examples.en: Export citations in BibTeX format for the LaTeX-based thesis template.
examples.zh: 论文的 LaTeX 模板要求用 BibTeX 格式「导出引文」。

words.enDefinition: to apply a style like APA or MLA to references automatically

examples.en: With one click you can format citations in APA style across the whole document.
examples.zh: 一键就能给整篇文档按 APA 样式「套用引用格式」。

examples.en: The plugin can format citations and build the bibliography at the same time.
examples.zh: 插件可以同时「套用引用格式」并自动生成文献目录。

words.enDefinition: to combine two saved records describing the same source

examples.en: Zotero flags duplicate entries; merge duplicates after each big import.
examples.zh: Zotero 会标记重复条目，每次大批量导入后要「合并重复文献」。

examples.en: Merge duplicates carefully so you don't lose the page numbers one record carried.
examples.zh: 「合并重复文献」要小心，别弄丢某条记录里的页码。

words.enDefinition: a shared workspace where teammates collect and tag sources together

examples.en: Our group library keeps every source for the presentation in one searchable place.
examples.zh: 「群组文献库」把展示要用的所有文献集中在一处，随时可查。

examples.en: Ask your teammates to add abstracts to the group library before the next meeting.
examples.zh: 请组员在下次会议前把摘要补充到「群组文献库」里。

words.enDefinition: to save the article file itself under its citation record

examples.en: Right-click the entry and attach a PDF so notes stay with the reference.
examples.zh: 右键该条目并「添加PDF附件」，笔记就能跟着文献走。

examples.en: If you only import metadata, remember to attach a PDF from the database later.
examples.zh: 如果只导入了元数据，记得之后再从数据库「添加PDF附件」。

collocations: attach a PDF to an entry

words.enDefinition: to weave quoted material smoothly into your own sentences

examples.en: Good writers integrate quotations by anchoring them to a claim in the previous sentence.
examples.zh: 高明的写法是「整合引文」，让引文锚定在上句的论点上。

examples.en: The tutor showed me how to integrate quotations instead of dropping them in cold.
examples.zh: 辅导老师教我如何「整合引文」，而不是生硬地把引文扔进去。

words.enDefinition: to prepare readers with a short phrase before quoted words begin

examples.en: Never let a quote open a paragraph; introduce a quote with your own claim first.
examples.zh: 别让引文直接开头，先亮出自己的论点来「引出引文」。

examples.en: Introduce a quote with the author's credentials so readers trust the evidence.
examples.zh: 「引出引文」时先说明作者背景，读者才会信任这个论据。

collocations: introduce a quote with a signal phrase

words.enDefinition: using the exact original wording with nothing altered

examples.en: Copy the definition verbatim and add the page number in your footnote.
examples.zh: 「一字不差」地照抄定义，并在脚注中标注页码。

examples.en: If it is not verbatim, it counts as paraphrase, so make that choice deliberately.
examples.zh: 若非「一字不差」照抄，就属于转述，要刻意做出选择。

words.enDefinition: expressing a source's idea through your own phrasing, not copied text

examples.en: Explain the theory in your own words, then cite the original chapter.
examples.zh: 先「用自己的话」讲清理论，再注明原始章节的出处。

examples.en: The professor can tell memorized textbook sentences from ideas explained in your own words.
examples.zh: 教授分得清背诵的教科书句子和「用自己的话」讲出的理解。

words.enDefinition: questioning a text's claims, methods, and evidence as you read

examples.en: Critical reading means asking who funded the study and what it leaves out.
examples.zh: 「批判性阅读」就要追问研究由谁资助、遗漏了什么。

examples.en: The seminar grade comes from critical reading notes submitted before each class.
examples.zh: 研讨课的成绩来自每次课前提交的「批判性阅读」笔记。

words.enDefinition: to judge whether a source is credible, current, and relevant

examples.en: Evaluate sources on authority and date before adding them to your annotated bibliography.
examples.zh: 把文献加进注释书目前，先按权威性和时效「评估来源」。

examples.en: The librarian gave us a checklist to evaluate sources in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 馆员给了一份清单，十分钟就能「评估来源」。

words.enDefinition: to confirm a source exists and says what you claim

examples.en: Verify a source before submitting; fabricated citations are an instant misconduct case.
examples.zh: 提交前务必「核实来源」，编造引用会直接构成学术不端。

examples.en: The TA circled one footnote and asked me to verify a source she could not find.
examples.zh: 助教圈出一条脚注，要求我「核实来源」，因为她查不到。

words.enDefinition: a source whose author, publisher, and evidence can be trusted

examples.en: A government report is usually a credible source for statistics on enrollment.
examples.zh: 政府报告通常是入学统计方面「可信的信息来源」。

examples.en: Anonymous blogs rarely count as credible sources in academic writing.
examples.zh: 匿名博客很少能算作学术写作中的「可信信息来源」。

words.enDefinition: a work written by researchers for an academic audience

examples.en: Distinguish a scholarly source from a magazine piece by checking for citations.
examples.zh: 看有没有参考文献，就能区分「学术性来源」和杂志文章。

examples.en: At least half of your list must be scholarly sources published within five years.
examples.zh: 文献列表至少一半必须是近五年发表的「学术性来源」。

words.enDefinition: a magazine or news item written for general readers, not researchers

examples.en: A popular source is fine for background, but arguments need scholarly evidence.
examples.zh: 「大众媒体来源」可作背景了解，但论证要用学术证据。

examples.en: The Atlantic article is a popular source, so pair it with the underlying study.
examples.zh: 《大西洋月刊》的文章属于「大众媒体来源」，要配上它引用的原始研究。

words.enDefinition: following rules that keep your work truthful and properly credited

examples.en: The syllabus dedicates a full page to academic honesty and citation expectations.
examples.zh: 课程大纲用整页篇幅讲「学术诚信」和引用要求。

examples.en: When in doubt about academic honesty, email the professor before submitting.
examples.zh: 拿不准「学术诚信」问题时，提交前先给教授发邮件。

words.enDefinition: reusing your own submitted work again without permission or disclosure

examples.en: Submitting last term's essay to a new course is self-plagiarism even though you wrote it.
examples.zh: 把上学期的文章交到新课属于「自我抄袭」，即使那是你自己写的。

examples.en: Ask the professor first; some allow self-plagiarism with prior written approval.
examples.zh: 先问过教授再说，有些课程允许经书面同意的「自我抄袭」。

words.enDefinition: borrowing without proper citation because of sloppy note-taking, not intent

examples.en: Unintentional plagiarism still counts, usually from notes that lose the quotation marks.
examples.zh: 「无意抄袭」照样违规，多半是因为笔记里丢了引号。

examples.en: Copy page numbers into your notes to prevent unintentional plagiarism later.
examples.zh: 做笔记时就抄下页码，避免日后出现「无意抄袭」。

words.enDefinition: restitching a source's sentences with small word swaps instead of real paraphrase

examples.en: Swapping synonyms sentence by sentence is patchwriting, and professors flag it quickly.
examples.zh: 逐句替换同义词就是「拼凑改写」，教授一眼就能识别。

examples.en: The tutor explained that patchwriting counts as plagiarism even with a citation.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释说，「拼凑改写」即使注明出处也算抄袭。

words.enDefinition: a website selling ready-made essays to students

examples.en: His roommate was suspended for submitting an essay bought from an essay mill.
examples.zh: 他室友因提交从「论文代写网站」购买的文章而被停学。

examples.en: Essay mill papers fail plagiarism scans because previous buyers already submitted them.
examples.zh: 「论文代写网站」的论文过不了查重，因为之前的买家已经交过。

words.enDefinition: paying another person to complete your assignment or exam

examples.en: Universities treat contract cheating as misconduct for both the buyer and the writer.
examples.zh: 学校把「花钱请人代写」视为买卖双方的学术不端。

examples.en: Sharing your campus login for contract cheating can end in expulsion.
examples.zh: 为「花钱请人代写」借出校园账号可能导致开除。

words.enDefinition: inventing results or observations that were never actually collected

examples.en: Data fabrication in a lab report can trigger a formal misconduct case.
examples.zh: 实验报告里的「编造数据」可能引发正式的学术不端调查。

examples.en: Fabricating interviews is data fabrication, even if the conclusions sound plausible.
examples.zh: 捏造访谈内容属于「编造数据」，即使结论听起来合理。

words.enDefinition: changing real results so they say more than they actually do

examples.en: Deleting outlier participants to save a hypothesis is falsifying data.
examples.zh: 为了保住假设而删掉离群被试，就是「篡改数据」。

examples.en: Falsifying data differs from fabrication: one edits real numbers, the other invents them.
examples.zh: 「篡改数据」不同于编造数据：前者改动真实数字，后者凭空捏造。

words.enDefinition: reusing passages from your own earlier papers in new submissions

examples.en: Journals screen text recycling with software, so rewrite rather than copy your methods section.
examples.zh: 期刊用软件筛查「文本重复使用」，方法部分请重写而非照搬。

examples.en: Minor text recycling of boilerplate is common, but disclose it to the editor.
examples.zh: 模板句的少量「文本重复使用」很常见，但要向编辑说明。

words.enDefinition: handing the same paper in for two courses without approval

examples.en: Double submission of one final essay for two seminars violates both syllabi.
examples.zh: 同一篇期末论文交两门研讨课属于「重复提交」，违反两份课程大纲。

examples.en: Ask both professors in writing; some permit double submission with disclosure.
examples.zh: 请两位教授书面确认，有些课程允许说明后的「重复提交」。

words.enDefinition: the habit of seeking only evidence that supports what you believe

examples.en: Confirmation bias creeps in when you search only for studies that agree with you.
examples.zh: 只搜支持自己观点的研究时，「确认偏误」就悄悄出现了。

examples.en: Counter confirmation bias by citing the strongest opposing article in your paper.
examples.zh: 在论文中引用最强的反方文章，可以对抗「确认偏误」。

words.enDefinition: false or misleading content spread without deliberate intent

examples.en: Health misinformation spreads fastest on the apps students use daily.
examples.zh: 健康类「错误信息」在学生常用的应用上传播最快。

examples.en: Check the original journal article before sharing, because summaries often carry misinformation.
examples.zh: 转发前先核对期刊原文，因为转述常夹杂「错误信息」。

words.enDefinition: to confirm claims against reliable evidence before trusting or citing them

examples.en: Fact-check every statistic against the original census report before it goes in your essay.
examples.zh: 每个统计数字都要对照普查原始报告「事实核查」后才能写进文章。

examples.en: The writing center tutors fact-check our citations line by line during appointments.
examples.zh: 写作中心的辅导老师会在预约时逐行对引文「事实核查」。

words.enDefinition: to check one source against another for agreement on facts

examples.en: Cross-reference the dates between the two articles before you quote either one.
examples.zh: 引用前先「相互印证」两篇文章中的日期。

examples.en: Wikipedia is a starting point: cross-reference its facts with the listed sources.
examples.zh: 维基百科只是起点：把其中事实与所列来源「相互印证」。

words.enDefinition: an extended research project seniors write to graduate with honors

examples.en: Her honors thesis on bilingual education runs to ninety pages with forty references.
examples.zh: 她的「荣誉学位论文」研究双语教育，长达九十页、引用四十条。

examples.en: Apply for the honors thesis seminar before junior year registration opens.
examples.zh: 大二选课开始前，就要申请「荣誉学位论文」研讨课。

words.enDefinition: the book-length original research required for a doctorate

examples.en: Her doctoral dissertation took five years of fieldwork in three provinces.
examples.zh: 她的「博士学位论文」花了五年在三个省份做田野调查。

examples.en: Doctoral dissertations are indexed in ProQuest, so full texts are searchable online.
examples.zh: 「博士学位论文」在 ProQuest 收录，全文可以在网上检索。

words.enDefinition: a short document outlining a planned study's question, method, and sources

examples.en: My research proposal needs a timeline, a budget, and a preliminary bibliography.
examples.zh: 我的「研究计划书」需要时间表、预算和初步文献目录。

examples.en: The committee returned my research proposal with questions about sampling.
examples.zh: 委员会退回我的「研究计划书」，要求补充抽样说明。

words.enDefinition: the rules protecting participants and integrity in academic studies

examples.en: Research ethics training is mandatory before any survey involving human participants.
examples.zh: 任何涉及人类被试的调查之前，都必须完成「研究伦理」培训。

examples.en: Our research ethics review required anonymizing every participant's real name.
examples.zh: 「研究伦理」审查要求匿名化所有参与者的姓名。

words.enDefinition: a participant's signed agreement to join a study after learning its risks

examples.en: Every interviewee signs the informed consent form before the recording starts.
examples.zh: 每位受访者都在录音开始前签署「知情同意书」。

examples.en: The ethics board rejected our draft because the informed consent language was unclear.
examples.zh: 伦理委员会驳回了草案，因为「知情同意」的表述不清楚。

words.enDefinition: a person sharing authorship of a paper or presentation

examples.en: My professor invited me to be co-author of the conference paper we revised together.
examples.zh: 教授邀请我担任我们共同修改的会议论文的「合著者」。

examples.en: List co-authors in the order agreed before submission, not by seniority alone.
examples.zh: 「合著者」按投稿前商定的顺序署名，而不只看资历。

words.enDefinition: a Word mode recording every edit for collaborators to review

examples.en: Turn on track changes so your advisor can see exactly what you revised.
examples.zh: 打开「修订模式」，导师就能看清你改了哪些地方。

examples.en: Review every suggestion under track changes carefully; some edits shift your meaning.
examples.zh: 逐条处理「修订模式」下的建议，有些改动会改变原意。
